Talent0_2Ability.name: 第二适格者
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 与机兵可以进行<buf ID=900088>[同步]</buf>；主动攻击后，若没有受到伤害，下一次主动攻击伤害提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>

Talent3_5Ability.name: 第二适格者
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
与机兵可以进行<buf ID=900088>[同步]</buf>；主动攻击后，若没有受到伤害，下一次主动攻击伤害提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>；
出击时，<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf><color=#F74848>+10%</color>；若周围<color=#F74848>2</color>格内敌机大于等于<color=#F74848>3</color>个，伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101402.name: 集束
101402.describe: 使用机枪攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.25</color>倍伤害，对耐久值最低的部位命中权重<color=#F74848>+50</color>

101403.name: 绝伦闪避
101403.SpecificEffects: 完全闪避攻击时，战后回复<color=#F74848>1</color>AP，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>1</color>次

101404.name: 跃袭
101404.describe: 选择周围<color=#F74848>4</color>格内<color=#F74848>1</color>名目标，目标周围<color=#F74848>1</color>圈可以停留，使用长柄对目标躯干造成<color=#F74848>1.25</color>倍伤害，之后停留在目标周围<color=#F74848>1</color>圈空地上

101405.name: 诛尽
101405.SpecificEffects: 对耐久值低于<color=#F74848>50%</color>的部位造成伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>

101406.name: 全面压制
101406.describe: 同时使用两把机枪攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>2×0.7</color>倍伤害，本次攻击目标无法发动反击

101407.name: 同步合击
101407.SpecificEffects: 使用格斗和突击武器对友军攻击的目标发动<buf ID=900002>[协力攻击]</buf>，造成<color=#F74848>0.2</color>倍伤害，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>2</color>次

101408.name: 破穹之矢
101408.describe:
使用长柄投掷<range type=1>直线4格</range>内所有目标（包括飞行目标），对首个目标造成<color=#F74848>1.5</color>倍伤害，之后每个目标倍率依次减少<color=#F74848>0.4</color>，战前可以进行<buf ID=900014>[瞄准]</buf>；
每次使用后AP消耗<color=#F74848>+1</color>，可叠加，行动结束时重置

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101431.name: 拔萃1
101431.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击时，根据自身耐久百分比提升暴击率，最多提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101434.name: 拔萃2
101434.SpecificEffects: 不会成为<buf ID=900023>[反击先手]</buf>、<buf ID=900013>[警戒射击]</buf>和<buf ID=900006>[反应攻击]</buf>的目标

101435.name: 拔萃3
101435.SpecificEffects: 主动攻击对战时，若自身耐久百分比大于等于目标，回避率提升<color=#F74848>25%</color>

101436.name: 拔萃4
101436.SpecificEffects: 行动开始时，获得<buf ID=1014363>[拔萃]</buf>，受到伤害时移除

101441.name: 天才1
101441.SpecificEffects: 第<color=#F74848>2</color>回合后，行动开始时，<buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf><color=#F74848>+5%</color>

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101444.name: 天才2
101444.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>还可以提升最终伤害，最多提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>

101445.name: 天才3
101445.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>在造成伤害时可以额外提升，受到伤害时不再下降

101446.name: 天才4
101446.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[同步率]</buf>大于等于<color=#F74848>85%</color>时，AP的回复值<color=#F74848>+1</color>
